summary: This Day 3 beginner progression guide for new Dragonheir servers outlines key goals across PvP and PvE content. It highlights effective free-to-play friendly team compositions for Grand Gladiator Arena, Temporal Vortex, and equipment dungeons. The guide stresses stamina efficiency by recommending talent dungeon farming over lower-tier gear farming. Additionally, it provides early-game priority upgrades for the newly unlocked Island feature.

heroes.name: Garius
heroes.note: Extremely reliable tank built with max Skill Haste to ensure high survivability and frequent healing.

heroes.name: Voresh
heroes.note: Blocks enemy buffs like immortality and defense boosts using Rift Hourglass for high Skill Haste and Accuracy.

heroes.name: Synarell
heroes.note: Provides team invincibility and heavy ultimate damage when geared with double Skill Haste sets.

heroes.name: Lossenia
heroes.note: Free legendary DPS hero that excels when built with Skill Haste and Witch's Remains artifact.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: Unlocked on Day 3 with his exclusive Ring of Winter artifact; stack Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Skill Haste for high burst.

teams.note: F2P arena defense built around fast skill haste to block enemy buffs early and cycle ultimates rapidly.
Budget-friendly summon-focused team capable of reaching 22M+ damage on the boss.

teams.mode: Grave of Curse / Grave of Rot
teams.note: Frost-based setup designed to clear up to Stage 8 easily.

tips: Clear Fey Meander up to Stage 80 as early as Day 3 using free units like Lossenia, Auster, Voresh, and Garius.
Do not waste stamina farming Epic equipment; clear up to Stage 8 in gear dungeons and save stamina for Talent Dungeons until Legendary gear unlocks on Day 7.
Prioritize upgrading the Dispatch Center on your Island to maximize Driftwood gathering for further island expansion.
Upgrade the War Room after the Island is expanded to unlock higher familiar attribute bonuses and combat talents.
Always purchase discounted Starlight Stone Dice from the Island Trading Post upon the daily 200 reset.
In Fallen Shadow Spire, save your challenge attempts and attempt the highest unlocked difficulty level based on server progression days (Days 3, 8, 15, and 23).
